Echo exercised upkeep ownership, source control and departure, trigger placement, payment, compact-CI data closure, and exact replay across several universal systems; the cross-owner correctness value outweighed its smaller card gain.

Crew became an architecture sentinel for advertised and submitted activation parity, effective power, summoning sickness, atomic tap commitment, layer-4 type results, projection, rollback, and replay; that foundation justified reranking it ahead of the counter queue.
